history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I'm going to set the Inquiry aside, because what you just said matters more. Thinking everyone would be better off without you, and pulling away from your friends, sounds really heavy to carry, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

I'm an AI, not a crisis service, but you can talk to a real person right now:

- **US:** call or text **988** (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- **UK:** call Samaritans on **116 123**
- If you're in immediate danger, call your local emergency services.

Are you safe right now? I'm here if you want to say more.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

That's okay, you don't have to call anyone. If talking out loud feels like too much, 988 also takes texts in the US, and Samaritans can be emailed at jo@samaritans.org in the UK.

We can do the breakdown. First I want to ask plainly, because you didn't say: are you thinking about ending your life or hurting yourself right now?
